testkit 0.1.0

A dependency-free assertion library for Basalt examples and package tests.

API

FunctionResult
check_int(actual, expected)1 when integer values are equal.
check_bool(actual, expected)1 when boolean values are equal.
check_char(actual, expected)1 when character values are equal.
check_string(actual, expected)1 when NUL-terminated byte strings are equal.
check_between(value, minimum, maximum)1 for an inclusive integer range match.
check_not_int(actual, unexpected)1 when integer values differ.

Example

include "packages/testkit/0.1.0/src/testkit.basalt"

func main(): int {
  let failures: int = 0;
  if testkit::check_int(2 + 2, 4) == 0 then failures += 1;
  return failures;
}
